comparisons.explanation: Precision@10 measures the percentage of top-10 recommended reviews that are genuinely actionable. The proposed engine avoids false alarms from negative market-wide dips.
Recall@10 measures the proportion of urgent client situations successfully captured in the advisor's top queue. Return-only fails to catch positive-return clients with deteriorating goal paths.
False Positive Rate measures non-urgent cases inappropriately surfaced. Lower is better. Return-only baseline inappropriately flags negative-return clients who are outperforming benchmarks.
Deterministic calculation agreement across planted unit test scenarios with known mathematical truths.

methodology_notes: Evaluation compares the proposed goal-aware explainable engine against a return-only baseline over a reproducible 200-client synthetic dataset with 12 planted test scenarios. Relevance labels represent verifiable financial review triggers (severe goal shortfall, multi-trigger risk, persistent underperformance, and critical data staleness).
limitations: Synthetic dataset contains fictional client profiles and modeled returns rather than live custodian feeds.
Initial heuristic weights (25/25/20/15/15) represent prototype defaults and have not undergone longitudinal clinical trials.
Advisor decision-support outputs are drafts requiring human advisor verification before taking action.
